description: This file declares the RemoteGateKeeperDevice class, which implements the IGatekeeper interface for remote gatekeeper operations such as enroll, verify, delete all users, and delete user. It includes method declarations, external dependencies, and class structure relevant to Android's gatekeeper security module.

classes.name: RemoteGateKeeperDevice
classes.description: Implements the IGatekeeper interface for remote gatekeeper operations, managing communication with the gatekeeper service via shared file descriptor channel.

methods.name: enroll
methods.description: Enrolls a password or PIN for a user, returning a response with the enrolled handle or error.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Verifies a provided password against the enrolled handle, returning verification response or error.

methods.name: deleteAllUsers
methods.description: Deletes all user data from the gatekeeper.

methods.name: deleteUser
methods.description: Deletes a specific user identified by UID.
